sentences.text: Jibeinia is an extinct genus of avialan belonging to the clade Enantiornithes.
It is classified within the family Gobipterygidae.
The species Jibeinia luanhera was described based on a nearly complete fossil, yet the original holotype is currently lost.
The holotype fossil never received a catalogue number or was accessioned by a museum.
A local farmer presented the holotype fossil to an engineer in the summer of 1993.
Researchers investigated the quarry at the Dongtuyao brick factory in Northern Hebei Province where the fossil was found.
Initial research placed the fossil in the Yixian Formation, but later geological studies showed it came from the similarly aged Huajiying Formation.
The genus Jibeinia has been proposed as a possible synonym for the genus Vescornis.
The genus Jibeinia was reclassified by O'Connor et al. in 2016.
Jibeinia lived during the Early Cretaceous period.
It lived between the Barremian and Aptian stages, approximately 125.77 to 119.57 million years ago.
Researchers suggest that Vescornis might be a junior synonym of Jibeinia, but this cannot be confirmed without rediscovering the lost holotype.
